svg.title: FIG-10 Independent Source SDK consumption Build-time flow; Native execution and ARM linking are separate
svg.desc: Clean Git source / locked dependencies / licenses Development fixtures require explicit selection; Selected profile.packages and package export ownership One ELF does not define the complete SDK; Package a complete prefix; verify identity/bytes read-only Manifest schema3: source_exports / profile; Relocate the complete prefix Do not move only its source subtree; Optional create --public Copy canonical GPIO project and explicit assembly; External consumer source and separate build find_package(Nexus CONFIG REQUIRED) Optional NEXUS_EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVISION; Verify SDK identity and bytes at every public boundary Source / locks / member scope / hashes; nexus_add_firmware() and package CMake Sole compile target graph; private SDK headers stay private; Explicit host-support consumer Actual configure / build / run; Exact MCU consumer Startup / linker / ELF / BIN / map / resources; Stale identity, changed bytes, missing members or wrong prefix Reject without reusing stale output; Actual consumer records and artifact identities No physical HIL or software-candidate qualification; Select packages and dependencies; Frozen source inputs; Export ownership, not a compile source graph; Complete package; Create a public starter; Reviewable source and commands; Existing external project consumes directly; Load public entry; Identity and boundaries accepted; Verification failed; Host support explicitly selected; Selected MCU assembly; Actual execution results; Actual link and resource results
